dedupe_keys.name: rnm us catalog of equipment for synthetic distribution systems

description: This data set gives the equipment catalogues used by the US Reference Network Model (RNM-US) to build large synthetic distribution systems. It was published on IEEE DataPort in 2020 by Carlos Mateo, Fernando Postigo, Fernando de Cuadra, Tomás Gómez, Tarek Elgindy, Pablo Dueñas, Bri-Mathias Hodge, Venkat Krishnan and Bryan Palmintier, so that users of the synthetic networks can see the component choices behind them. The catalogues cover the Greensboro synthetic system (version 0.2) and the San Francisco Bay Area synthetic system (version 0.8), which span low-voltage lines, distribution transformers, medium-voltage feeders, primary substations, sub-transmission and transmission substations. Files include catalogues for primary substations in delta-wye and wye configurations for each area. Coverage is the two US regions. Files are small Excel workbooks downloadable from IEEE DataPort after login, last updated May 2022, under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: IEEE DataPort shows a subscription notice, so access may need a free account or subscription, and the synthetic networks themselves are hosted elsewhere (DR POWER and BetterGrids). Simulation uses are building or extending synthetic distribution networks for planning and power flow. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
